style.styleTitle: Homcom Set of 2 4ft Pre-Lit Pine Christmas Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Enhance your entryway or living space with this set of 2 pre-lit pine artificial Christmas trees anchored in rustic wooden-barrel style pot bases. Featuring dense PVC leaves, pine needles, natural pine cones and red berries, each tree offers 11 dual-colour lighting modes via remote control—allowing adjustments without leaving your seat. Battery powered and flame-retardant, they bring safe, symmetrical charm for young and fluffy friends. . Set of 2 pine trees anchored in wooden-barrel style pot bases provides a balanced, symmetrical accent; . Blended PVC foliage and detailed pine needles deliver dense, multi-textured evergreen depth; . Pre-decorated with natural-looking pine cones and red berry clusters for instant festive charm; . Pre-lit LEDs feature 11 dynamic lighting functions switching between warm white and multicolour; . Remote control allows you to change lighting modes without leaving your seat; . Cordless and compact size design offer placement flexibility away from power outlets and small spaces; . Flame-retardant PVC leaves and strong steel trunk ensure home fire safety and stability; . Sectioned trunk structure for space-saving storage; . Colour: Green, Red, Brown; . Light Colour: Warm White / Multicolour; . Material: PVC, Steel, PP; . Overall Dimensions: F55 x 120H cm; . Pot Base Dimensions: F20 x 17H cm; . Branch Tip Count: 131 (Per Tree); . Light Count: 100 LEDs (Per Tree); . Power Supply: Battery Box Powered (Requires 3 x AA Batteries, Not Included); . Remote Control: 5m Range (Requires 1 x Battery, Included); . Item Label: 83C-337V00GN; . Note: Approx. 10-15 minutes of manual tip shaping per tree recommended to achieve full natural density.
